title: SynIL: Leveraging Synergy for Offline Imitation Learning from Imperfect Demonstration Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2609.38225v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire complex skills directly from massive demonstration datasets, but its performance degrades severely when datasets are contaminated with suboptimal or noisy demonstrations. While prior quality-assessment methods attempt to filter or reweight data, they typically rely on manual pre-selection of expert reference data or task-specific heuristics, limiting scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce SynIL (Synergy-based Imitation Learning), a novel framework for automated, label-free demonstration quality assessment in offline reinforcement learning. Grounded in neuroscientific evidence that motor synergy, a low-dimensional coordinated structure in movement, correlates directly with motor proficiency, SynIL algorithmically quantifies synergy manifestation to generate dense, transition-level reward signals via self-supervised reward regression. Comprehensive evaluations on D4RL locomotion

translated_title: SynIL：利用协同效应从不完美演示数据集中进行离线模仿学习
translated_abstract: 模仿学习使机器人能够直接从大规模演示数据集中习得复杂技能，但当数据集中混入次优或有噪声的演示数据时，其性能会严重下降。先前的数据质量评估方法虽然尝试对数据进行过滤或重新加权，但通常依赖人工预先筛选的专家参考数据或特定任务的启发式规则，限制了可扩展性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SynIL（基于协同效应的模仿学习），这是一个面向离线强化学习的新型框架，能够实现自动化、无标签的演示质量评估。基于神经科学证据——运动协同（即运动中一种低维的协调结构）与运动熟练程度直接相关，SynIL通过自监督奖励回归，以算法方式量化协同效应的表现，从而生成密集的、转移级别的奖励信号。在D4RL运动控制任务上的综合评估（原文在此截断）……
tldr: SynIL基于运动协同与运动熟练度直接相关的神经科学原理，通过自监督奖励回归生成密集奖励信号，实现了自动化、无标签的演示质量评估，从而解决了模仿学习中数据集包含次优或噪声演示导致性能下降的问题。
en_tdlr: SynIL leverages neuroscientific insights that motor synergy correlates with motor proficiency to enable automated, label-free demonstration quality assessment via self-supervised reward regression, addressing performance degradation in imitation learning caused by suboptimal or noisy demonstrations.
